name: Paleteria La Michoacana
notes: 5 photos of illuminated menu boards and printed lists. Photo 5 (the clearest, English-labeled board covering snacks, classicos, beverages, ice cream and dulces) had the most legible priced items and was used as the primary source. Photos 1 and 4 show an older/duplicate purple-and-pink board with the same or similar dish names at different prices (superseded, skipped to avoid duplicates). Photos 2 and 3 are numbered/handwritten flavor lists for nieves and paletas (Chicle, Rainbow Sherbet, Mango, Fresa, etc.) with no prices attached to individual flavors, so they were treated as a flavor catalog rather than menu dishes and omitted; per-scoop nieve pricing from photo 1 was likewise a duplicate of the Ice Cream Helados pricing already captured.
